title: NWPC affirms P42 minimum wage hike in Central Visayas

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P42-minimum wage increase for private sector workers in Central Visayas was affirmed by the National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC). This was confirmed by Labor Secretary and NWPC Chairperson Francis Tolentino at the commission’s deliberation, which was held at the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Regional Office VII in Cebu
